_comment: Centres d'activité EXPAT (polygones APPROXIMATIFS, ordre lng,lat). Zones où les expats vivent/travaillent/sortent — utile pour lire la demande locative solvable. Pour ajuster/ajouter : éditer ici puis `npm run geo:corridors`.

zones.name: Sukhumvit core (Asok–Phrom Phong–Thong Lo–Ekkamai)
zones.note: Main Western & Japanese expat belt: offices, nightlife, intl. supermarkets. Deepest rental demand in town.

zones.name: Silom–Sathon–Lumpini (CBD & embassies)
zones.note: Historic CBD: banks, law firms, embassies, French/European community. Strong corporate-lease demand.

zones.name: Riverside (Charoen Krung–Khlong San)
zones.note: Hotels, Icon Siam, creative district. Lifestyle/retiree expats; premium river-view rentals.

zones.name: Ari
zones.note: Hip cafés/co-working pocket; young professionals and nomads. Small but tight rental market.

zones.name: On Nut–Phra Khanong (budget expat / nomads)
zones.note: Value end of the Sukhumvit line: digital nomads, teachers. High turnover, price-sensitive demand.

zones.name: Rama 9–Ratchada (new CBD, Chinese community)
zones.note: G Tower/Unilever offices, Chinese & Korean communities, embassy of China. Growing white-collar rentals.

zones.name: Nichada Thani / ISB (family compounds, Pak Kret)
zones.note: Gated family-expat enclave around International School Bangkok. Houses more than condos — rent-side reference.

zones.name: Bang Na–Trat corridor (intl schools, Mega Bangna)
zones.note: Berkeley/Bangkok Patana side of town + Mega Bangna. Family demand tied to school run distances.
